status: WORKING DRAFT, accepted by the operator 2026-10-21 19:15 PT (built by the strategic window at his request, 2026-10-21). Thresholds are a-priori drafts, to be calibrated when the mass tier is built; never fitted to outcomes.
structure: Same as NBA v4: role archetypes (players are weighted hybrids across them) + cross-cutting modifiers. Each archetype carries group, name, notes, signals, threshold; each modifier name, notes, threshold. GG-### in a threshold = the signal has no free source yet.

F-1.name: Elite Scoring Driver
F-1.notes: Primary goal scorer, top PP unit
F-1.threshold: ixG/60 top decile; PP1 TOI share >= 60%

F-2.name: Playmaking Center / Distributor
F-2.signals: primary assists/60, shot assists, zone-entry passes

F-3.name: Two-Way / Shutdown Forward
F-3.notes: Trusted against top lines, defensive zone starts
F-3.signals: xGA/60 on-ice, DZ start share, QoC
F-3.threshold: xGA/60 bottom third with DZ starts >= 55%

F-4.name: Power Forward / Net-Front
F-4.notes: Scores from the slot and crease, physical

F-5.name: Transition / Speed Forward
F-5.notes: Drives controlled entries and rush chances
F-5.signals: controlled zone-entry rate, rush shots, skating speed (EDGE)
F-5.threshold: Controlled entries top quartile; EDGE top-speed bursts top quartile

F-6.name: Shooter / One-Timer Specialist
F-6.notes: Volume and shot quality from distance

D-1.name: Puck-Moving / Offensive D
D-1.notes: Drives play from the back end
D-1.signals: primary assists, controlled exits, shots/60, PP time
D-1.threshold: Controlled exit rate top quartile; PP TOI share high

D-2.name: Shutdown / Defensive D
D-2.notes: Kills plays, top-pair minutes against top lines
D-2.signals: xGA/60 on-ice, blocks, PK time, QoC
D-2.threshold: xGA/60 bottom third vs top QoC

D-3.name: Two-Way Number-One D
D-3.signals: TOI, xGF% on-ice, PP and PK time

D-4.name: Physical / Stay-at-Home D
D-4.threshold: Hits+blocks top quartile, points/60 bottom half

G-1.name: Elite Starter
G-1.threshold: GSAx/60 top quartile on >= 60% of starts

M-3.name: Elite Skating / Speed
M-3.threshold: EDGE max-speed and bursts top decile

M-11.name: Line-Chemistry Dependent
M-11.threshold: On-ice xGF% drop >= 5 pp away from the linemate

M-12.name: Deployment-Sheltered
M-12.threshold: OZ start share >= 65% and QoC bottom third

M-13.name: Heavy-Minutes / Fatigue-Sensitive
M-13.threshold: TOI top decile with back-to-back split >= 15%

M-18.name: Goalie: Volume-Sensitive
M-18.threshold: Save % split by shots faced >= 1.5 points

M-20.name: Developmental Upside
M-20.notes: Young player on a steep curve

M-21.name: Veteran Decline
M-21.threshold: Age 32+ with falling speed and on-ice xGF%

M-22.name: High Variance / Streaky
M-22.threshold: sd of rolling points/60 top quartile

M-23.name: Low Variance / Floor
M-23.threshold: sd of rolling points/60 bottom quartile
